Make e3_evidence_bundle.py require the expanded exact package set and verify each digest against workspace bytes.
Add verifier-visible adversarial tests that tamper each Step008 trust-anchor file and require rejection.
Retain fixed-function-only, loopback-only, USER_SPACE, no arbitrary command input, and E3_promoted=false boundaries.
Rerun Step005-007 regressions plus Step008 tests; Builder may only claim BUILT_NOT_VERIFIED.
root_cause: The owner-run bundle attests only six pre-Step008 package files. It does not bind the exact Step008 PREPARE_E3_OWNER_RUN.ps1, E3_OWNER_RUN_CONTRACT.json, or e3_evidence_bundle.py bytes that create/validate the bundle. A workspace-local replacement of these Step008 trust-anchor files can therefore occur without being represented in e3_owner_run_bundle.json, violating the required workspace-tamper fail-closed chain.
